notes:
benchmarking_db 1259: baseline/delta adjudication of the 8 INT/VRA rules (INT32-C, INT30-C, INT10-C, INT33-C, ARR30-C, INT34-C, INT31-C, INT16-C) after the 53853e78 commit floor.

METHOD. Population = Postgres realworld run 260 (sqc-0.4.336-53853e78, queued by dev-41 on main 2026-09-18 08:31, benchmark host dev-41), i.e. exactly the task's commit floor; its per-project codebase_commits equal the pinned checkouts on dev-468 (bench corpus-check: all 12 detached at their pins, trees clean). Unlabeled keys pulled with BenchDB.list_realworld_unlabeled(260, rule) -- the same (project, relpath, line, rule) basis score_realworld_run uses -- then filtered through aurora-lint's bench.corpus.in_scope (path-aware globbing, data/benchmark_repos.json), because list_realworld_unlabeled does not scope. Raw 812 -> in-scope 715; out-of-scope drops were sqlite src/tclsqlite.c (44) and test_*/fuzz files, curl lib/vtls/schannel.c + system_win32.c (WIN_MAC), mosquitto fuzzing/ and examples/. Two in-scope keys already labeled on benchmark_adjudication main by task-1101-vra-int-rules-delta (PR #11, not yet in Postgres) were excluded. valkey's src/fuzzer_*.c are in scope: linked into the shipped valkey-benchmark binary (src/Makefile ENGINE_BENCHMARK_OBJ), consistent with the earlier INT16-C valkey batches.

GATE CHECK (CLAUDE.md delta-adjudication step): the only open FP-reduction task against these rules is aurora_lint 1258 (P4, four narrow VRA non-zero/in-bounds proof shapes, ~8 findings of evidence) -- not a blanket driver, so not gated on. aurora_lint 914's ARR30-C pointer-arithmetic half was never picked up (no follow-up task exists); noted, not gated on.

CORRECTIONS to the task body: only valkey is a true baseline gap (its 735 prior labels are all INT16-C); mbedtls (8,583 labels) and ventoy (2,478) already had oracles built 2026-09-14 covering these rules, so their leftovers are delta. The ~1816 headline predates the floor, those oracle builds, raylib's INT30/INT32 delta batches, valkey's INT16-C batches and aurora_lint 1257; at run 260 the whole in-scope backlog is 715, of which valkey is 692.

Adjudication: each finding read in its source context at the pinned commit (function body, guards, callers where the operand crosses a call boundary), verdict per the established per-rule conventions in the existing labels (e.g. INT10-C: FP when the dividend is provably non-negative -- rand()/random() output, unsigned types, loop indices, short-circuit guards; TP when a genuinely signed value reaches % with no non-negativity guard even if practically benign). Adjudicator: claude-opus-5 on dev-468, single pass, no adversarial re-verification in this batch.
BATCH B1 of 6: valkey INT10-C, all 163 in-scope unlabeled keys at run 260 (the whole valkey INT10-C population; valkey had no INT10-C labels before).

RESULT: 158 FP / 5 TP.
- 128 are 'rand() % <positive constant or count>' (109 of them in src/fuzzer_command_generator.c, the fuzzer's random argument generator; plus lolwut5/6, sentinel, util, valkey-cli), plus random()/randomULong()/serverLrand48() variants (cluster_legacy, dict, kvstore, script_lua): FP -- the dividend is a non-negative PRNG output by the C/POSIX standard, so the remainder cannot be negative. One systemic shape, not 128 judgment calls; a checker that treated rand()/random() as a non-negative source would clear every one of them.
- 2 are unsigned arithmetic misread as signed (dict.c:906 unsigned long, script_lua.c:837 size_t).
- 23 are argc-difference / loop-index / config-bounded / accumulated-monotonic-time dividends provably non-negative by construction or by a short-circuit guard on the same line.
- 5 TP: debug.c:896 (DEBUG SLEEP argument, user-controlled sign, remainder stored into tv_nsec) and localtime.c:71/75/76/81 (one root: a signed time_t adjusted by tz/dst reaches % with only a header comment as the guard; the derived seconds/days inherit its sign). All low practical severity.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys, as ground_truth is keyed. No precision/recall claim is made here; that is for the scorer once these rows are in ground_truth.
